SHOW CAUSE NOTICE FOR DISALLOWANCE OF INPUT TAX CREDIT
Notice Ref: SCN/164/2023/404 Dated 01-12-2023
GSTIN: 27DDDDD1111D1Z1 M/s Buildcon Infra
FY: 2018-19

1. It is alleged that taxpayer availed ITC of Rs. 3,20,000/- in GSTR-3B filed for September 2019 return period after statutory deadline under Section 16(4).
2. Show cause why ITC of Rs. 3,20,000/- should not be recovered under Section 73.
